text: Screen Alternative: Weekly Exploration Basket — plastic kitchen tools, fabrics, natural elements (paper, rocks). Let him explore freely — he is learning physics, textures, cause/effect without a screen.

review_defects.why: The Arabic lists four items: physics, tissues, textures, cause/effect. The English omits 'tissues' (الأنسجة) and merges 'textures' (القوام) into one, losing the distinction.
